Subject: HeliosData onboarding packet and DPA (initial)

Hi Irene —

Thanks for taking us through the intake form earlier. Per our discussion, attached are: the signed DPA (redwood-dpa-signed.pdf), our current subprocessor register (subprocessors_2027-11-10.csv) and a short vendor profile.

Key asks from our side so we can finish the activation: 
- Confirm PO recipient and billing code so we can route the invoice.
- Confirm whether any additional evidence is required (SOC 2 link, questionnaires, penetration test reports).
- Let us know if the subprocessor list needs additional columns (processing purpose, data residency).

Attachments (all small PDFs/CSV): redwood-dpa-signed.pdf (signed copy), subprocessors_2027-11-10.csv, helios-vendor-profile.pdf

If easier, feel free to loop procurement and legal to the thread directly — copied Ben and Rishi here.

Thanks,

Amanda —

Received, thanks for sending. Quick read-through and a couple of clarifying items from our side before procurement creates the PO: 

1) Subprocessor register: can you add a column for "Processing purpose" and "Data residency (country)"? Our procurement intake needs that for internal routing and risk scoring.
2) Retention: please confirm the default retention period for customer data (e.g., 90/180/365 days) and whether there are any exceptions.
3) SOC 2 / evidence: if you have a read-only link to your SOC 2 report (or an auditor letter), please share. That will let our security team sign off faster.

Ben — can you confirm the billing contact we should supply Amanda and whether Net 30/Net 45 is standard for this deal size?

Rishi / Kimberly — if you want to review the DPA copy I can redline, but it looks like a standard executed DPA — I left it in the attachments.

Irene
Irene Choi

Thanks, Irene —

I've attached an updated subprocessor CSV with the extra columns (subprocessors_2027-11-14-updated.csv). The CSV includes processing purpose and country for each subprocessors entry. To summarize: most processing is in US (us-east-1, us-west-2), with analytics processing in Ireland (eu-west-1) through an analytics subprocessor.

Retention: default is 365 days for customer-derived logs; user-facing content retention can be configured (we support 90/365/indefinite depending on the plan).

SOC2: we have a read-only Drive link for our SOC 2 Type II report — I can open it to Redwood reviewers if that helps.

Attachments: subprocessors_2027-11-14-updated.csv

Let me know the PO path and any forms you need from procurement/finance.

—Amanda

Amanda —

Thanks for the update and the CSV. From procurement side here's what we need to finish the PO: 

1) Billing contact (name + email) we should put on the invoice.
2) W-9 (US) or EU VAT registration (if billing from EU).
3) Confirmation of invoicing cadence (one-time vs monthly) and whether invoices should be sent to invoices@heliosdata.com.

Standard terms for this engagement are Net 45 unless otherwise negotiated. I’ll create the PO once the billing contact + W-9 are in, and I’ll share the PO number back to this thread.

Attached: PO template (po-template-RED-2027.pdf) — this contains Redwood billing codes. Use billing code RD-SW-2027-STD unless Finance instructs otherwise.

Subject: RE: Vendor activation: DPA evidence gap analysis & PO routing

Amanda —

Thanks for the updated subprocessors list and the retention note. A couple of quick points from Security & Legal: 

• SOC 2 access: please share the read-only link to your SOC 2 Type II report (we prefer a time-limited Drive link or auditor portal link). That will let us close the security checkbox.
• Subprocessor red flags: the analytics subprocessor in Ireland looks fine; please confirm whether that subprocessor uses subcontractors (i.e., a downstream subprocessor list). If yes, include their names.
• Retention confirmation: please reply in writing with the agreed default retention period and a note if customers can request shorter retention (we need a written confirmation for contract records).

Once those three items are provided, Legal will mark the vendor as approved from a privacy/compliance perspective and Procurement can issue the PO.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
